pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   C. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.
   C. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Islamic Law? (1 mark)
   A. Use Administration of Islamic Law to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Islamic Law.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Administration of Islamic Law has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.
   B. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

11. Which response best shows understanding of Bequest? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bequest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Bequest has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bequest.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Administration of Islamic Law and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Inheritance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Bequest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. D — Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Administration of Islamic Law; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bequest; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Finance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
